description: This file defines classes and constants for handling ASN.1 data structures, including Buffer, OID, and Sequence classes, with functions for encoding, decoding, and parsing ASN.1 data types.

classes.name: Buffer
classes.description: A class representing a buffer with reference counting and size management for ASN.1 encoding.

classes.name: OID
classes.description: A class representing an Object Identifier with parsing and string conversion capabilities.

classes.name: Sequence
classes.description: A class representing an ASN.1 sequence, providing methods for parsing ASN.1 encoded data.

methods.name: Buffer(const uint16_t length)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes buffer with specified length.

methods.name: Size(const uint16_t length)
methods.description: Sets the size of the buffer.

methods.name: Size() const
methods.description: Returns the size of the buffer.
